exposure: women pregnant for the third time or greater vs less than 3 times
women who opted for repeat caesarean section
women who opted for a trial of labor
labor induced with Foley catheter vs not
outcome: outcome of a trial of labor
cohort: 796 women with a prior caesarean section from the national database of a Slovenian hospital between January 2014 to July 2019.
finding: The rate of successful vaginal delivery following a trial of labor is high, but could be improved with more conservative management during the first stage of labor.
mod_finding: 84.1% of women that opted for a trial of labor after a previous caesarean section had a successful vaginal delivery.
